scenes.vo: You lose up to one centimeter of height every single day.
Don't panic. Gravity compresses your spinal discs while you walk and sit.
Here are three simple habits to decompress your spine and reclaim your height.
Number one: the dead hang. Just sixty seconds on a bar gently decompresses the spine.
Number two: lie flat on a firm floor for ten minutes after work to release tension.
Number three: sleep on your back so your discs naturally rehydrate overnight.
And there's way more inside our app. Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
